Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: When opening the Britannica page, WebSurfer surfaced the “Quick Facts” line showing “Born: December 10, 1960, Reading, Berkshire, England,” which contradicts the widely corroborated birthplace of Belfast, Northern Ireland. This reflects a misinterpretation/over-reliance on an erroneous or outdated snippet without immediate cross-verification against other authoritative sources. Had this been used as the answer, it would have led to the wrong birthplace.
